item.title: THE POWER RANKINGS: Westwood solidifies top spot in Austin Boys rankings
item.description: With two more wins over ranked teams, including a convincing road win over their nearest district competitor in Vandegrift, the Westwood Warriors have seized control over the Boys Power Rankings at (roughly) the halfway mark in district play. Because Westlake looked stronger in their two wins than did Lake Travis last week, the Chaps reclaimed the #2 spot over the Cavs with Bowie joining the 26-6A parade at #4.
